images.prompt: Create an original natural color tabletop product photograph of exactly one unbranded brushed stainless steel carafe and one empty clear cylindrical drinking glass on a matte light-gray table. The tall carafe stands at left with a single curved handle on its left side and a short pouring lip pointing right. The shorter glass stands at right, separated from the carafe by a visible gap. A soft rectangular window reflection runs vertically down the metal; gentle daylight enters from image left. Plain warm-gray wall behind, precise realistic material reflections and contact shadows, ordinary color photography with intact midtones. Show both objects completely with space above and below. Vertical 4:5 image, exactly 1024x1280 pixels. No additional utensils, brands, text, watermark, frame or special photographic effects.

review.reason: Independent inspection confirms two complete still-life objects: one metal carafe with a single open loop handle, oval mouth and right pouring lip, plus one separate transparent glass. Reflection positions, ellipses and support shadows are coherent; no text.

images.actual_source_analysis: Actual source: a tall tapering brushed stainless steel carafe stands at left, with a wide open oval mouth, a short right-facing pouring lip and a single large curved handle attached on the left.
